# Cupappen

Cupappen is a public catalogue of football (soccer) tournaments in Sweden, published in Swedish (`sv-SE`).

## Canonical site
- Homepage: https://www.cupappen.se/

## What this site is for
- Help teams, clubs, and parents discover upcoming and past cups.
- Provide one place to filter by date, category/district, free-text search, then open a dedicated page per cup.

## URL patterns (important)
- **Cup detail (primary, SEO/SSR):** `https://www.cupappen.se/{district}/{slug}-{year}`
  - Example: `https://www.cupappen.se/skane/tjejcupen-2026`
  - `{district}` is the ingest-source / federation district slug (e.g. `skane`). Empty source uses `ovrigt`.
  - `{slug}` is derived from the cup name (ASCII slug). `{year}` is taken from start/end date when available to disambiguate recurring names.
- **District listing (SPA):** `https://www.cupappen.se/{district}/` (e.g. `/skane/`)
- **Search (SPA):** `https://www.cupappen.se/sok/` — optional `?q={term}` (and `?date=all` when showing all dates). Prefer this over legacy `#search` hashes.
- **Districts index (SPA):** `https://www.cupappen.se/distrikt/` — A–Ö picker of federation districts (also linked from the home page and bottom bar).
- **Other listing paths (SPA):** `/kommande/`, `/alla/`, `/info/` (still valid; primary chrome is Hem / Distrikt / Info).
- Legacy redirect: older links like `/cup/{slug}-{year}` or `/cup/{id}-{slug}` 301 to the district URL when the cup exists.
- Homepage `https://www.cupappen.se/` loads the interactive listing (featured + time rows + district picker). Each visible cup also has the dedicated detail URL in the sitemap.
- Favicon: `/favicon.ico` redirects (301) to `/favicon.svg`.

## Machine-readable metadata
- Cup detail pages are **server-rendered HTML** (not only a client shell) and include:
  - `rel=canonical`, `hreflang` (`sv-SE`, `x-default`), Open Graph and Twitter tags.
  - **JSON-LD** (`@graph`): `Organization`, `WebSite`, `WebPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, and `SportsEvent` (sport: fotboll). When reviews exist, `aggregateRating` may be present on the `SportsEvent`.
- The homepage includes base JSON-LD (`Organization`, `WebSite`, `CollectionPage`, `SearchAction` targeting `/sok/?q={search_term_string}`) plus a dynamic `ItemList` of `SportsEvent` items emitted after cups load (IDs/URLs use the same detail pattern as the UI).
- SPA listing routes update `document.title`, `canonical`, and Open Graph URL client-side to match the path.

## Ratings & user content
- Authenticated **public** POST to `POST /api/ratings.php` (JSON) attaches a star rating + optional text to a `cup_id`.
- GET returns aggregate stats and recent reviews. Rate limits apply (e.g. cooldown per IP/cup).
- Summaries in JSON-LD reflect aggregate scores when data exists; individual comments are in the visible HTML.

## Sitemaps & discovery
- XML sitemap: https://www.cupappen.se/sitemap.xml
  - Includes homepage, `/sok/`, `/kommande/`, `/distrikt/`, `/info/`, district listing URLs (`/{district}/` including `/ovrigt/` when applicable), and cup detail URLs (`/{district}/{slug}-{year}`).
  - Prefer **www** in Search Console (apex redirects can drop paths).

## Data freshness & accuracy
- Cup records are ingested/updated from organisers and sources over time. Fields (dates, venues, links) can change; prefer the on-page values and `lastmod` hints in the sitemap where present.

## Preferred short citation
Cupappen — https://www.cupappen.se/
